mentions.name: Vinyl-Tags
mentions.description: A set of command line tools for preparing analog (e.g., vinyl) recordings for addition to music libraries: fetches metadata and cover art from Discogs or generates it, co-runs with Audacity to locate track boundaries efficiently, and writes the metadata into the audio tracks.
mentions.source_excerpt: Vinyl-Tags: a set of command line tools to facilitate the process of preparing analog recordings for addition to music libraries. Fetch metadata and cover art from Discogs (or generate your own); co-run with Audacity to locate track boundaries efficiently; add the metadata to the audio tracks.
